title: Compare floor division to a cast integer
description: Write a function `floor_div_equals_int_cast(a, b, c)` that returns whether `a // b` equals `int(c)`.
hints: Idea to consider: // rounds down to a whole number, and so does int() on a positive float
7 // 3 discards the remainder and gives 2. int(2.7) discards everything after the decimal point and also gives 2 - two different operations landing on the same value.
expected_behavior: Returns True if the floor division equals the int-cast value.
solution:
def floor_div_equals_int_cast(a, b, c):
    return (a // b) == int(c)
explanation: // and int() both truncate toward a whole number, but they operate on different things - // works on the division itself, int() works on an already-computed float - so it's worth checking they actually agree rather than assuming it.
